import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic

theorem rmo_2000_6 :
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 ∧ n = a * b} 10) := by
  -- Part 1: Show 10 is achievable with a=2, b=5 (or similar)
  -- Part 2: Show 10 is achievable with a=2, b=5 (or similar)
  -- Then prove minimality by analyzing prime factorizations
  constructor
  · -- Prove IsLeast for first set
    refine' ⟨_, _⟩
    · -- 10 is in the set
      use 2, 5
      norm_num [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
    · -- 10 is the least element
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, heq⟩
      have : 10 ≤ n := by
        rw [heq]
        have h2000 : 2000 = 2^4 * 5^3 := by norm_num

          exact Nat.dvd_trans (by simp [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]) hdiv
        have h5 : 5^3 ∣ a^2 * b^5 := by
          exact Nat.dvd_trans (by simp [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]) hdiv
        -- Analyze valuations to show ab ≥ 10
        have : 2 ≤ a + b := by
          by_contra! h
          have : a + b ≤ 1 := by linarith
          have : a = 0 ∨ b = 0 := by omega
          cases this with
          | inl ha' => contradiction
          | inr hb' => contradiction
        have : 5 ≤ a + b := by
          by_contra! h
          have : a + b ≤ 4 := by linarith
          have : a ≤ 4 ∧ b ≤ 4 := by
            constructor <;> omega
          rcases this with ⟨ha', hb'⟩
          interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> norm_num at hdiv ⊢ <;>
            (try omega) <;> (try contradiction)
        omega
      exact this
  · -- Prove IsLeast for second set
    refine' ⟨_, _⟩
    · -- 10 is in the set
      use 2, 5

    · -- 10 is the least element

          exact Nat.dvd_trans (by simp [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]) hdiv

          exact Nat.dvd_trans (by simp [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]) hdiv

          have : a + b ≤ 1 := by linarith

          cases this with
          | inl ha' => contradiction

        have : 5 ≤ a + b := by
          by_contra! h
          have : a + b ≤ 4 := by linarith

```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

theorem rmo_2000_6 :
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 ∧ n = a * b} 10) := by
  constructor
  · -- first set: a²·b⁵ divisible by 2000
    refine ⟨?mem1, ?least1⟩
    · -- 10 belongs to the set
      refine ⟨1, 10, ?ha, ?hb, ?hdiv, rfl⟩
      · decide
      · decide
      · -- 2000 ∣ 1²·10⁵
        norm_num
    · -- any element of the set is at least 10
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      -- from the divisibility we get 2 ∣ a·b and 5 ∣ a·b
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact this.trans hdiv
        have hprime2 : Nat.Prime 2 := Nat.prime_two
        have h2aorb : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 ∨ (2 : ℕ) ∣ b ^ 5 :=
          (hprime2.dvd_mul).1 h2
        rcases h2aorb with h2a | h2b
        · have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := (hprime2.dvd_pow).1 h2a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left this b
        · have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := (hprime2.dvd_pow).1 h2b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right this a
      have h5ab : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h5 : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
          have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact this.trans hdiv
        have hprime5 : Nat.Prime 5 := Nat.prime_five
        have h5aorb : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 ∨ (5 : ℕ) ∣ b ^ 5 :=
          (hprime5.dvd_mul).1 h5
        rcases h5aorb with h5a | h5b
        · have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := (hprime5.dvd_pow).1 h5a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left this b
        · have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := (hprime5.dvd_pow).1 h5b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right this a
      -- 2 and 5 are coprime, hence 10 ∣ a·b
      have h10ab : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have hcop : Coprime (2 : ℕ) (5 : ℕ) := by
          decide
        exact hcop.dvd_mul h2ab h5ab
      -- therefore 10 ≤ a·b
      exact le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) h10ab
  · -- second set: a³·b⁴ divisible by 2000
    refine ⟨?mem2, ?least2⟩
    · -- 10 belongs to the set
      refine ⟨1, 10, ?ha, ?hb, ?hdiv, rfl⟩
      · decide
      · decide
      · -- 2000 ∣ 1³·10⁴
        norm_num
    · -- any element of the set is at least 10
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact this.trans hdiv
        have hprime2 : Nat.Prime 2 := Nat.prime_two
        have h2aorb : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 ∨ (2 : ℕ) ∣ b ^ 4 :=
          (hprime2.dvd_mul).1 h2
        rcases h2aorb with h2a | h2b
        · have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := (hprime2.dvd_pow).1 h2a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left this b
        · have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := (hprime2.dvd_pow).1 h2b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right this a
      have h5ab : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h5 : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 := by
          have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact this.trans hdiv
        have hprime5 : Nat.Prime 5 := Nat.prime_five
        have h5aorb : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 ∨ (5 : ℕ) ∣ b ^ 4 :=
          (hprime5.dvd_mul).1 h5
        rcases h5aorb with h5a | h5b
        · have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := (hprime5.dvd_pow).1 h5a
